units.source_text: 汉武帝命画师毛延寿画宫女像。

en.t: Emperor Wu of Han ordered the court painter Mao Yanshou to paint portraits of the palace women.

units.source_text: 王昭君不送毛延寿黄金，

en.t: Because Wang Zhaojun did not give Mao Yanshou any gold,

units.source_text: 毛延寿把她的容貌画得很丑，

en.t: Mao Yanshou painted her face as very ugly,

units.source_text: 武帝信以为真，将王昭君遣嫁胡人。

en.t: Emperor Wu believed it was true and sent Wang Zhaojun away to marry a Hu man.
